observations: White caged IBC tote in center with metal frame and tap at base
Black vertical ribbed plastic tanks stacked on left side
Black tank on right with white spade logo and partial unreadable text
Black ribbed circular open-top tank in foreground
Second white caged IBC tote partially visible on right edge

claims.claim: We use it to store water in our house and different places
claims.evidence: Photos show water tanks but cannot confirm seller's usage history or locations

risks.risk: Tanks may have cracks, splits, or leaks not visible from the outside
risks.proof: Close-up photos of tank interiors, seams, and bottoms, or a water fill test video

risks.risk: IBC tote may have previously held non-food chemicals rather than water
risks.proof: Close-up of labels, UN/DOT markings, or previous contents sticker on the IBC cage

risks.risk: Taps and valves may be broken, seized, or missing
risks.proof: Video of tap operation and water flow

proof_requests: Close-up of IBC tote labels and previous contents markings
Interior shots of all tanks to check for cracks or residue
Video of taps running water to confirm no leaks
response.reason: The items are identifiable as used water storage tanks; even with unverified condition, they can be priced at worst case as used containers with potential leaks.
